topic: Linear Transformations and Matrices: The Geometry of Change

sections.title: Prerequisites & The Intuitive Leap (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: Vectors are arrows in a 2D plane.
Transformations move grid lines while keeping them parallel.
The origin must remain fixed during transformations.
Imagine the grid stretching like spandex fabric.
This motion is a linear transformation.

sections.title: Defining the Basis Vectors (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: Any transformation is defined by basis vectors.
Observe the unit vectors i-hat and j-hat.
Where they land determines the entire transformation.

sections.title: The Matrix Representation (1:45-3:00)
lecture_lines: We use a 2x2 matrix for storage.
The first column shows where i-hat lands.
The second column shows where j-hat lands.
Multiplying a vector applies these precise instructions.
The matrix encodes the full spatial change.

sections.title: Application: The Game Character Transformation (3:00-4:15)
lecture_lines: Matrices transform objects, like game characters.
A shear matrix leans the character sideways.
It keeps the feet on the ground.

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis (4:15-5:00)
lecture_lines: Matrices are instruction manuals for space.
They represent change through linear maps.
Remember: Transformation is Matrix times Vector.
